children: Crypto trader Ansem said airdrops remain one of the strongest catalysts for bringing users and trading activity back on-chain. According to ChainCatcher, he noted that many trading terminals generated significant volume in the last cycle, but many platforms have still not rewarded users.

Ansem said intensifying competition among platforms for traders is making rewards for early users an effective way to build loyalty and retain liquidity. He added that past experience shows well-timed airdrops can unlock substantial on-chain activity, and he expects the strategy to reappear in the current cycle.

title: Ansem Says Airdrops Remain a Key Catalyst for On-Chain Activity
